arithmetic: Exact native integers/decimals/ratios; MLflow floats are diagnostic displays. No hidden rounding before aggregation.
unknown: Unknown observations are not zero; retain known subtotals and applicability/exclusion counts.
paired_comparison: candidate-baseline on identical applicable completed case/expectation/repetition identities; also show full planned completion/error counts. Mean paired delta uses n paired samples; latency quantile delta compares named quantiles, not mean of per-row quantiles.
